summary: The demon summoning helper and the later monster combat route are implemented. The accepted replay now matches all 180 steps; the whole combat task resolved the later mismatch that remained after demonpet completion.

source.branch: Complete demonpet(): print the message; choose ndemon(u.ualign.type) only when rn2(6)==0, otherwise use the current form; call makemon at the hero with NO_MM_FLAGS; if creation succeeds, call tamedog with a null object and FALSE; then exercise A_WIS in C order.
callers: uhitm.c:damageum lines 4835-4854 calls demonpet after the initial damage roll when the hero form is a demon, rn2(13)==0, no weapon is wielded, and the form is neither amorous demon nor Balrog; uhitm.c:hmonas reaches damageum from the polymorphed hero attack. js/uhitm.js:damageum now calls the complete demonpet implementation under the matching guard.
dependencies: minion.c:ndemon is already implemented in js/minion.js and source-pinned by scripts/minion.test.mjs; it supplies the selected aligned demon species only on the rare rn2(6)==0 branch. No completion claim for ndemon is included in this task.

makemon.c:makemon and its asynchronous runtime tail already support explicit monster creation at the hero square with NO_MM_FLAGS; its returned monster is checked before the source-discarded tamedog result.
dog.c:tamedog is implemented in js/dog.js; C discards its result at this call.
attrib.c:exercise is implemented in js/attrib.js; C discards its result at this call.
